_meta.note: Cute creature set for region 2 (Gary Oct 23 2026: 6 cute ones per region; dev notes: 'each later region's build includes its own 6 cute creatures'). All single-stage. Built by coder_cute_r2 (Oct 27 2026).
_meta.dex_no: PROVISIONAL numbers continuing after cute_r1 (454-459), until Gary/World Design slot them. DEX_450 itself is not edited; tools/sync_creatures.mjs reads design/cute_sets/cute_r*.json.

wild.why: Region 2 cute set lives in region 2 grass (East Trail and the Aurelith-Saltmere salt road), mixed with existing spawns

creatures.name: Haysquee
creatures.habitat: East Trail hay meadows and field edges
creatures.visual_brief: Chubby baby guinea pig: honey-gold and cream patchy fur, russet eye patch, head rosette, tiny pink ears, crown of woven golden hay with a red clover. Crystal: small violet crystal set in the hay crown.

creatures.name: Dunehop
creatures.habitat: Salt road dunes between Aurelith and Saltmere
creatures.visual_brief: Baby jerboa-like dune hopper: sandy-beige body, cream belly, huge round pink-lined ears, long springy hind feet, very long thin tail ending in a sea-salt white puff with pale aqua tips. Crystal: small violet crystal between its ears.

creatures.name: Belugoo
creatures.habitat: Saltmere shore tide pools and wet sand
creatures.visual_brief: Baby beluga calf that wriggles on land: pearly white skin with lilac shading, rounded melon forehead, happy smile, small flipper arms, curled tail fluke, natural navy sailor-collar marking. Crystal: small violet crystal on top of its head.

creatures.name: Okapip
creatures.visual_brief: Baby okapi calf: chocolate velvet body, cream face with dark muzzle, cream-and-brown striped legs and rump with tiny lilac sparkles, big soft ears, two rounded head nubs. Crystal: small violet crystal between its ears.

creatures.name: Crownlet
creatures.habitat: Sunny hedgerows on East Trail at dawn
creatures.visual_brief: Round rose-pink and cream songbird chick puffball with an orange beak, fanned pink-and-white tail, and a crown of blue bellflowers. Crystal: small violet crystal at the centre of the flower crown.

creatures.name: Kinkalume
creatures.habitat: Salt road palms and lamp posts after dusk
creatures.visual_brief: Baby kinkajou: honey-gold fluffy fur, cream face, amber eyes, long prehensile tail curled into a hook that carries a small glowing orange paper lantern. Crystal: small violet crystal on its forehead.
